description: This file defines the interface and implementation for a broadcast channel provider used in Orleans. It includes a public interface 'IBroadcastChannelProvider' for obtaining channel writers, and an internal class 'BroadcastChannelProvider' that implements the interface, manages internal state, and provides factory methods.

classes.name: BroadcastChannelProvider
classes.description: Implements IBroadcastChannelProvider, manages broadcast channel creation, and provides a factory method for creating instances with dependency injection.

methods.name: GetChannelWriter
methods.description: Returns a new instance of BroadcastChannelWriter for the specified channel ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new BroadcastChannelProvider instance using dependency injection.
